seo.title: Kumashishini · ChatSched
seo.description: Bhukisha abapapashi nabavelisi bokwenene baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuthe ngqo — akukho ekhawunti yentengiso, akukho ukubhida, akukho ii-alghorithm. Intlawulo igcinwe kwi-escrow, iiphulo ezilandelelweyo, ubungqina xa sele ibonakala.

hero.title: Fikelela kubaphulaphuli abasele bethenjiwe ngabathengi bakho.
hero.subtitle: I-ChatSched idibanisa amashishini amancinci aseMzantsi Afrika ngokuthe ngqo namaphepha, abavelisi, kunye neendlela abathengi babo abasele bezilandela — akukho alghorithm, akukho ekhawunti yentengiso, akukho mfazwe yokubhida. Uhlawula kuphela xa umntu wokwenene eqinisekise ukuba ukubonakaliswa kwakho kuyasebenza.

howItWorks.title: Ukusuka kwisicelo ukuya ekusebenzeni, ngamanyathelo amane.

steps.title: Fumana indlela yakho
steps.body: Khangela amaphepha entlalo, abanomtsalane, iiwebhusayithi, iipodcast kunye neeslothi zomsakazo ngokohlobo, iphondo kunye nabaphulaphuli ukufumana into efanelekileyo kubathengi bakho.

steps.title: Ngenisa isicelo
steps.body: Khetha umpapashi kwaye uthumele isicelo sokubonakaliswa esichaza into ofuna ukuyibonakalisa — akukho mlawuli we-akhawunti, akukho ekhawunti yentengiso, akukho mlinganiselo osezantsi wokuchitha.

steps.title: Hlawula kwi-escrow
steps.body: Xa umpapashi evumile, hlawula ngokhuseleko ngekhadi, i-EFT ekhawulezayo, okanye i-EFT eyenziwa ngesandla. Imali ihlala kwi-ChatSched — hayi kumpapashi — de ukubonakaliswa kube kusebenza ngokwenene.

steps.title: Fumana ubungqina, hayi izithembiso
steps.body: Jonga isicelo sakho sisuka ekungenisweni siye ekusebenzeni, ufumane ubungqina xa sele kwenzekile. Akukho ukuqikelela ukuba uhlahlo-lwabiwo mali lwakho luye phi.

howItWorks.escrowLink: Bona umzila opheleleyo we-escrow kunye nokuhlawulwa →

channels.title: Bhukisha naphi na apho abathengi bakho bakhona.
channels.subtitle: Indlela nganye engezantsi isebenza ngomjelo ofanayo olula wesicelo-negunyaziso — khetha ezo zifanelekileyo.

tools.title: Isixhobo esipheleleyo sentengiso, hayi nje uluhlu.
tools.subtitle: Xa sele ubhalisile, ezi zixhobo zihlala kwibhodi lakho kunye nezicelo zakho.

items.name: Match
items.body: Chaza ishishini lakho ngolwimi olucacileyo — fumana uluhlu olucwangcisiweyo lwabapapashi abafanelekileyo ngokwenene.

items.name: Isicwangciso Sokufikelela
items.body: Isikhokelo esikhokelayo esiguqula injongo isibe sisicwangciso kunye neshedyuli.

items.name: Isitudiyo Somxholo we-AI
items.body: Ifoto enye okanye ibali libe ziifomathi ezilithoba ezilungele ukupostwa — Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, nokunye.

items.name: Umakhi Wephulo
items.body: Guqula ibali elilula ngolwimi ibe liphulo elifakelwe amanqaku, kunye neengcebiso zokulenza ngcono.

items.name: Umlandeleli Wephulo
items.body: Amakhonkco okulandelela okwenyani kwiphulo ngalinye — iinqindilili, iindwendwe, iinkokeli kunye noguqulo, hayi izilinganiselo.

items.name: Umbali-Manani we-ROI
items.body: Faka uhlahlo-lwabiwo mali, fumane ukufikelela okuqikelelweyo nombuyekezo phambi kokuba uzibophelele.

comparison.title: Imarike ethe ngqo, hayi iqonga lentengiso.

rows.us: Uyazi ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba ngubani okubonakalisayo kwaye kutheni befanelekile kubathengi bakho.
rows.them: Isaziso sakho sikhuphisana ngengqalelo ngaphakathi kwi-alghorithm engaziwayo.

rows.us: Abapapashi bahlolwa ngesandla phambi kokuba baliswe.
rows.them: Amanani okufikelela azichazwa ngokwabo kwaye awanakuqinisekiswa ngamaxesha onke.

rows.us: Intlawulo ihlala kwi-escrow de ukubonakaliswa kuqinisekiswe kusebenza.
rows.them: Uhlawula ngaphambili kwaye unethemba lokuba i-alghorithm izokunika okulindelekileyo.

rows.us: Iindlela zasekuhlaleni, ezithenjiweyo abathengi bakho abasele bezilandela.
rows.them: Ngokuya kuya kuvinjwa zizivimbi zezaziso kwaye zingahoywa ngenxa yokungananzelwa kweebhaneri.

escrowStrip.title: 🔒 Imali ayihambi de umsebenzi wenzeke
escrowStrip.body: Intlawulo yakho ihlala kwi-escrow — hayi kumpapashi — de ukubonakaliswa kwakho kuqinisekiswe kusebenza. Umpapashi uhlawulwa ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-{{hours}} emva kokuqala ukusebenza. Akukho namnye othwala umngcipheko yedwa.

items.a: Akukho sivumelwano nangayiphi na indlela. Ukukhangela kusoloko kusimahla — ukuthumela isicelo kufuna ukwenziwa okwesihlandlo esinye kwe-ChatSched Business (R399, ngokwesihlandlo esinye — ayihlaziywa nanini na), ekwavula intengiso elawulwayo kwaye ibandakanya ikhredithi yokuqalisa engange-R199.
Wonke umpapashi nomvelisi uphononongwa ngesandla phambi kokuba baliswe, kwaye baphethe amanqaku okuthenjwa kunye nezinga elakhelwe kwimbali yephulo yokwenyani — hayi nje inani labalandeli.
Xa umpapashi evumile isicelo sakho, unentsuku ezi-{{days}} zokuhlawula kwi-escrow. Igcinwa apho — ingakhutshelwa kumpapashi — de ukubonakaliswa kuqinisekiswe kusebenza.
Abapapashi banentsuku ezi-{{days}} zokuvuma okanye ukwala isicelo. Ukuba asenziwanga nto ngaphakathi kwelo xesha, iyavaleka ngokuzenzekelayo — awusoze walindela ngonaphakade.
Amaphepha nemiqulu yentlalo, abanomtsalane, iiwebhusayithi, iipodcast kunye neeslothi zomsakazo — konke ngomjelo ofanayo wesicelo-negunyaziso.
